about:
Skydrop Energy, based in Athens, Illinois, has been providing solar installation services across Central Illinois since 2018. The company was established to help homeowners, businesses, and farms transition to renewable energy, with a focus on reducing energy costs and environmental impact.

The company specializes in turnkey solar solutions, handling every step from educational consultation and custom system design through permitting, installation, and final system activation. Its installation teams work on residential rooftops, commercial buildings such as offices, warehouses, and retail stores, and agricultural properties including farms, ranches, and greenhouses, offering both roof-mounted and ground-mounted arrays.

Skydrop serves a mix of residential, commercial, and agricultural customers throughout Central Illinois. Residential clients include homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills and increase property value. Commercial clients range from office parks to warehouses and retail outlets. Agricultural clients encompass farms, ranches, and greenhouse operations looking to cut operational costs.

The company distinguishes itself with a free initial estimate and a hassle-free process that includes handling all permitting paperwork. It emphasizes expert installation by qualified electricians and ongoing maintenance support, aiming to deliver reliable, American-made panel systems backed by long-term warranties.
